title: Coal farming locations
text: Palworld 1.0 field route. Bamboo Groves Watchtower at map coordinates (-233, -365) has 5 Coal nodes in an open, flat area that can also work as a mining base. Anubis Dunes at (-128, -81) has 4 Coal nodes just off the cliff north of the travel point. Turtacle Terra reduces the carried weight of Coal and Sulfur by 80 percent while it is in the party.

title: Coal mining clusters and uses
text: Palworld 1.0 route options. Verdant Brook has Coal clusters at (190, -41) and (291, -19), with nearby Ore. Twilight Dunes has dense Coal around (-158, -93) and (-98, -121); bring heat protection. North of Duneshelter at (327, 485) has about 9 Coal nodes plus some Ore. Mt. Obsidian at (-570, -652) is an endgame Coal and Sulfur option requiring strong heat protection. Coal is used for Carbon Fiber and Refined Ingots. A Coal Quarry provides passive base production after it is unlocked and built.
